PAUSE FIRST, THEN STUDY

Not more classes. Stop and think first.

Every student is different. When the way you study is wrong, more hours only add more tiredness. So first understand how you study: re-reading feels easy, but testing yourself is what makes it stick. Watching the teacher solve gives you understanding, but trying it yourself is what works in the exam.

More classesThe right method
More notes, more hours, same methodFewer hours, testing yourself (active recall)
The teacher solves, you watchTry first, then a hint, then solve it yourself again
All revision at once, just before the examRevision in small gaps over days (spaced)
Phone nearby, focus breaking again and again25-minute focus blocks, phone in another room

You don't need to stop tuition or coaching. With the right method, you get the full value of every class.

THE 3-DAY PLAN

What you'll learn in 3 days

One pillar each day. You can use every technique on your own board syllabus the same week.

DAY 1

Memory & Brain

Remember faster.

  • How the brain remembers
  • The Hook and Link methods
  • A memory palace for formulae and lists
DAY 2

Study & Focus

Solve maths on your own, and stay focused.

  • Active recall and spaced revision
  • A 4-step routine for when you get stuck:
    1. Write the question in your own words
    2. Write down what you already know
    3. Try a smaller or similar example
    4. Read the solution, close it, and solve it again yourself
  • Focus blocks
DAY 3

Mindset & Learning

Build your own study habit.

  • Self-talk and exam confidence
  • Your own routine, based on your learner type
  • Certificate when you complete all 3 days

The goal: learn to study on your own, so every tuition and coaching hour actually works.

QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Your questions

Who is this workshop for?

Class 10 and Class 12 students with board exams in 2027: CBSE or State Board; Science, Commerce or Arts; Hindi or English medium. Parents are welcome to sit in.

Do I have to stop tuition or coaching?

No. We don't replace tuition. We teach you how to remember what you study and how to solve questions on your own, so you get the full value of your tuition too.

Board exam 2027 is close. Why this workshop now?

Because every hour of the months that are left should count. Start the right method today, and every revision gives you more.

Is it for Science, Commerce and Arts?

Yes. Ways to remember, revise and focus work in every subject. We practise the 4-step maths routine live.

Do you guarantee marks?

No. Results depend on your own practice. We teach the method; using it every day is up to you.

What is the learner-type survey?

A free 3-minute survey that looks at your study habits today: how you study, when you revise and what you do when you get stuck. It doesn't give you a fixed “brain type”. Habits can change, and that is what the workshop teaches.

Will you sell another course at the end?

No. This is the full course: every technique from all 3 days, the worksheets, the certificate and the WhatsApp community are included in this fee. There is no sales pitch at the end of the sessions.

What language is the workshop in?

The live classes are taught in Hinglish (a mix of Hindi and English), so everyone can follow easily. You can ask your questions in English or Hindi.

When and how do the classes happen?

Every Saturday, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST, LIVE on Zoom, not recorded. You get a confirmation after you register, and the joining link is shared in the WhatsApp community group before the first session.

Is this based on real science?

Yes. Learning research rates active recall and spaced practice among the most effective study techniques. With every technique you also learn why it works in the brain: not just “how”, but “why” too.

What is the refund policy?

Attend the full workshop. If you don't find it valuable, contact us within 24 hours of the last session and you get a full refund.

Why is it free? What's the catch?

No catch. We are a new academy, so we keep the first batches free, so students can try the method properly. All 3 LIVE days, the worksheets, the WhatsApp community and the certificate are free. If the workshop helps you, we will ask for your honest feedback at the end. That's all.

What do I need to join?

A smartphone, tablet or laptop, a stable internet connection and the Zoom app (or a browser). No prior knowledge needed: we start from the basics.

What if I miss a session?

Attending LIVE is best, so you can ask questions. Recordings, when available, are shared in the WhatsApp community group.

Email support@superlearneracademy.in or message us on WhatsApp.
